public_brief.objective: Get the new player betting quickly.
public_brief.tactic: Say yes plainly, give the house name, and ask for a stake.
public_brief.visible_cue: He shrugs and squares the deck.
public_brief.reply_to: Do you lot play blackjack? I don't know your fancy games.
public_brief.kit_focus: A plain yes, the house name for the game, then the stake question.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: give a plain yes with a little flourish

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: The chair legs scrape and Wren drops into the empty seat. The dealer looks at her over his cards for a moment, then shrugs one elegant shoulder and squares the deck.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: Blackjack. Yes, yes, we play it, though here we call it Twenty-One Coffins, because it sounds better by candlelight. Same game: get near twenty-one, never over, and beat the house. What will you stake, my plain-spoken guest?
